name: SA:COOP Server
author: sa-coop-fork@users.noreply.github.com
description: Dedicated server of the SA:COOP fork (GTA San Andreas co-op). One UDP port. Settings in server.ini, data in server-data.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SA:COOP dedicated server: a release's Linux archive into /mnt/server.
# A reinstall replaces the program and keeps server.ini, balance_exclude.ini and server-data.
# VERSION "latest": the newest release of the repository, test builds (pre-releases) included.
set -e
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates tar
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    VERSION=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases?per_page=1" | grep -m1 '"tag_name"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
    if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "No release found in ${GITHUB_REPO}"
        exit 1
    fi
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server /tmp/sa-coop
cd /tmp/sa-coop
curl -fsSL -o server.tar.gz "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/coop-server-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
tar -xzf server.tar.gz --strip-components=1
cp coop-server /mnt/server/coop-server
chmod +x /mnt/server/coop-server
for f in server.ini balance_exclude.ini; do
    [ -f "/mnt/server/$f" ] || cp "$f" "/mnt/server/$f"
done
cp README.md /mnt/server/README.md
echo "${VERSION}" > /mnt/server/release.txt
echo "SA:COOP server ${VERSION} installed"

variables.name: Release
variables.description: Release tag of the fork to install, as on its releases page. latest: the newest release at the time of the install, test builds included.

variables.name: Repository
variables.description: GitHub repository the release comes from, as owner/name.
